**Question.** How many public companies will show a market cap above USD 1 trillion on CompaniesMarketCap after the US close on 18 December 2026, 20 trading days from now.

**Starting point.** CompaniesMarketCap's ranking, read on 20 Nov with US prices from the 19 Nov close, shows 14 companies above $1T: Apple, Microsoft, Nvidia, Alphabet, Amazon, SpaceX, TSMC, Saudi Aramco, Broadcom, Meta, Tesla, Anthropic ($1.271T), Berkshire Hathaway ($1.215T) and Eli Lilly ($1.203T). Walmart sat at $999.96B and Samsung at $896.8B after a 7.3% drop in its latest session, followed by JPMorgan ($850B), AMD ($810B) and Micron ($781B). On 12 Nov (Revista Mercado, citing the same site) the count was also 14, with Samsung in and Anthropic not yet listed.

**What moves the count.**
- Walmart is on the line. It beat and raised its outlook on 19 Nov and was quoted at $130.22 (+3.3%) around 10:55 ET on 20 Nov (24/7 Wall St. quote page), about $1.03T. A 3% cushion against a typical four-week move of 6-7% gives roughly 60% that it finishes above.
- Anthropic listed on 19 Nov at $83, closed at $97.17 and traded near $86 on its second morning (StockTitan, 24/7 Wall St., 20 Nov). On the site's share count it falls below $1T under about $76, some 8% below the IPO price. With the VIX near 31 and Nvidia down 35% in a month, I give it about 57% to hold.
- Samsung needs about +12% (near 18%). AMD and Micron need +35% or more (about 5% each). Lilly, Berkshire, Tesla and Broadcom have cushions of 17-35%; I allow 1-3% each for a fall below the line.

**Other outcomes.** 16 or more needs a sharp AI rebound that lifts Samsung while Walmart and Anthropic both hold. 13 or fewer needs both to slip, or a deeper rout that takes Tesla, Broadcom or Lilly under. No new listing above $1T is expected in time: OpenAI has only filed confidentially.

**Forecast.** 14: 37%, 15: 32%, 13: 14%, 16: 8.5%, 17 or more: 3.5%, 12: 3%, 11: 1%, 10 or less: 1%.
